actual_rule_observed: Under explicit sidebar config, frontmatter sidebar.order is ignored entirely: position is the entry's index in the sidebar array, so equal order values cannot produce a tie.

frontmatter_used.description: Probe page testing whether frontmatter sidebar.order matters under explicit config.
frontmatter_used.title: P3 Tie Probe

notes: Canonical P3 run against the default starter setup (explicit sidebar array). A tie in sidebar.order values is not expressible here because frontmatter order keys have no effect: the entry with sidebar.order: 0 placed last in the array landed at flattened index 2. Hence no tie-break rule (title vs slug) applies to the default setup. True tie semantics were measured in the EXTRA-AUTOGENERATE run (two pages sharing sidebar.order: 5); see notes field of that extra build.
